title: An in vivo orthotopic serial passaging model for a metastatic renal cancer study
protocol: Euthanize mice using an approved protocol.
Resect tumor-bearing kidneys from three or more mice.
Incubate resected kidneys with a D-Luciferin potassium salt-PBS solution (12.5 mg/mL).
Add 200 μL of the luciferin-PBS solution per kidney.
Incubate for 5 minutes.
Visualize and quantify bioluminescence using in vivo bioluminescence imaging.
Separate tumor from the kidney.
Mince collected kidneys with a scalpel into pieces smaller than 1 mm cubic.
Dissociate mince tissue with collagenase.
Collect minced kidney in 400 unit/mL type-I collagenase dissolved in native cell culture media without FBS.
Incubate the collected tissue at 37°C for 30 min.
Filter the cell suspension through a cell strainer.
Pass tumor chunk through a 40-μm nylon cell strainer into a 50 mL tube.
Transfer cell suspension to a 15 mL tube.
Centrifuge the cells at 400 × g for 10 minutes.
Remove and discard supernatant.
Wash cells with PBS.
Add 5 mL of PBS to the pellet.
Centrifuge again at 400 × g for 10 minutes.
Remove and discard the PBS.
Liberate red blood cells using ACK lysing buffer.
Incubate sample in ACK lysing buffer for 5 min.
Add 9 mL of PBS to neutralize the lysing buffer.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 10 minutes.
Remove supernatant and discard.
Stain dead cells with Zombie Aqua Fixable Viability Kit.
Incubate cells with diluted Zombie Aqua Fixable Viability Kit for 10 min.
Add 9 mL of 2% FBS-PBS to dilute the staining solution.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 10 minutes.
Remove supernatant and discard.
Fix cancer cells using 4% PFA-PBS.
Incubate cells in 4% PFA-PBS for 10 min.
Add 9 mL of 2% FBS-PBS to wash the fixed cells.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 10 minutes.
Remove supernatant and discard.
Add 100 μL of 1:10 FcR Blocking Reagent diluted in 2% FBS-PBS.
Transfer samples into a U-bottom 96 well plate.
Incubate at room temperature (18°C–25°C) for 10 min.
Centrifuge at 110 × g for 10 min.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 100 μL of antibody cocktail.
Incubate at room temperature (18°C–25°C) for 30 min.
Add 100 μL of 2% FBS-PBS.
Centrifuge at 110 × g for 10 min.
Discard the supernatant.
Wash with 2% FBS-PBS.
Add 200 μL of 2% FBS-PBS.
Centrifuge at 110 × g for 10 min.
Discard the supernatant.
Analyze with a flow cytometer.
Inoculate 1.0 × 10^5 cells suspended in 50 μL for renal subcapsular inoculation.
